chunks: “And an abandoned well and a lofty palace.”
He said: “The abandoned well is the silent Imam, and the lofty palace is the speaking Imam.”
And Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā narrated it from al-ʿAmrakī, from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, from Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, similarly.

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ الصَّامِتُ: the silent Imam, an Imam not outwardly manifest in public proclamation
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ النَّاطِقُ: the speaking Imam, an Imam openly expressing and establishing guidance
key_terms.بِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ: an abandoned well, interpreted here as the silent Imam
key_terms.قَصْرٍ مَشِيدٍ: a lofty or strongly built palace, interpreted here as the speaking Imam
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: similar to it; indicating a parallel transmission of the same meaning

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the abandoned well and lofty palace in Shia tafsir?
ai.summary: This narration gives an esoteric explanation of the Qur'anic image of an abandoned well and a lofty palace. It identifies the abandoned well as the silent Imam and the lofty palace as the speaking Imam, indicating ranks of divinely appointed authority and guidance.
